notes:
CRM notes (shorthand) - recent activity and technical constraints:
- Background: regional clinic chain (15 hospitals + network of outpatient clinics). Heavy PHI; legal requires HIPAA + customer-managed keys + per-request audit logs.
- Primary project: replace keyword-based EHR search with vector-backed RAG for clinician summaries and chart retrieval. Also reranking for prioritizing most-relevant recent notes.
- Index scale: ~20M clinical notes (historical), growing ~2M/month. Avg doc length ~1.2k tokens; plan to chunk by section (SOAP, HPI, Meds).
- Embeddings: prefer per-tenant embeddings; testing both 1536- and 3072-d models. Concern: embedding storage cost + vector DB replication across regions for DR.
- Reranking: two-stage pipeline desired: fast embedding recall (latency target 30-50ms per call) + lightweight cross-encoder rerank for top-K (target end-to-end 150-200ms P95).
- Throughput: peak of 800 qps for triage bots; sustained 120 qps average across clinics. Batching and KV cache critical to meet cost targets.
- Cost constraints: business wants <$0.10 per complex query (embedding + recall + rerank) at scale; wants model quantization / mixed-precision recommendations.
- Networking/security: must run inside customer VPC, no public egress for PHI; HSM integration for CMK; syslogs shipped to Splunk; SAML SSO + SCIM required.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown; per-route latency SLOs; redaction filter audit trail for PHI exposures.
- Quote from Dir. of Engineering: "We will not compromise PHI controls — encryption + auditable access are non-negotiable."
- Proof-of-concept so far: hosted sandbox with 500k deidentified notes. Demo 2026-03-02 (ff_2026_03_02_oxley_demo). SE ran latency tests: single-node embedding latency 22ms, vector recall 45ms (cold), cross-encoder rerank 120ms for top-10.
- Legal/security asks: sample DPA + HIPAA addendum; pen-test report; SOC2 Type II or equivalent mapping. Drive: oxley-security-deck-2026.
- Procurement timeline: pilot decision by 2026-04; if pilot ok, contract Q2 2026.
- POC scope requested: on-prem minimal footprint (3 GPU nodes) + dedicated control plane in VPC; ingest pipeline + incremental indexing; daily audit log export to Oxley Splunk instance.
- Internal contacts: Dir. Engineering: Priya Nair (priya.nair@oxley-intelbridge.com), CISO: Tom Hargreaves.
- Shortcuts/notes: "ask for a per-query cost sheet with batching assumptions (batch size 8/16), and a fallback plan to smaller quantized model when capacity constrained."
- Next meetings: security deep-dive (Mar 10) - Rafael + Maya + Oxley security team; on-prem scoping (week of Mar 22) - infra + SE.
